issues.description: Ingest commits valid rows before enforcing the malformed-row threshold, so a failed ingest still mutates the database.
Upserts unconditionally overwrite existing jobs, allowing older snapshots to regress terminal states back to stale RUNNING/Unknown data.
Failure reports filter for OOM instead of Slurm's OUT_OF_MEMORY state, so real OOM failures are omitted.
Rows with missing columns can raise AttributeError and abort parsing instead of being counted as malformed rows.
Rows with extra pipe-delimited fields are silently accepted because DictReader's overflow field is never checked.
Timezone-aware timestamps are accepted but stored as raw strings, setting up incorrect chronological comparisons downstream.
Date filtering and newest-record logic compare timestamp text lexicographically, which is wrong for mixed timezone offsets.
Report output renders untrusted user/partition/state fields without stripping terminal control characters.
